title: Bayanin Asusun Lamuni
key_sentences: Ya zuwa ranar 15 ga Oktoba 2026, sauran bashin da ake bin ki shi ne N76,125.
Ana roƙon ki da ki biya kashi na ƙarshe kafin ko a ranar 31 ga Oktoba 2026 domin ki samu damar karɓar sabon lamuni a damina mai zuwa.
An caje ki tarar N1,500 saboda jinkirin biyan kashi na huɗu, kuma an riga an cire ta daga ajiyarki.
Idan kina da tambaya, ki ziyarci reshenmu ko ki kira lambar wayar da ke sama.

list_items.text: • Ku adana amfanin gona a rumbu mai tsabta domin guje wa ƙwari.
• Ku sayar da ridi lokacin da farashi ya tashi, ba lokacin girbi kaɗai ba.
• Ku halarci taron ƙungiya na kowane wata domin samun horo kyauta.

furniture: Reshen Dutsin-Ma, Titin Kasuwa, Jihar Katsina
Wannan bayani an samar da shi ta kwamfuta kuma baya buƙatar sa hannu. Shafi 1 cikin 1
